subject: Ciências
description_pt: Descrever e destacar semelhanças e diferenças entre o ciclo da matéria e o fluxo de energia entre os componentes vivos e não vivos de um ecossistema.

components.description_pt: Descrever como a matéria circula entre produtores, consumidores, decompositores e componentes abióticos de um ecossistema
components.description_en: Describe how matter cycles among producers, consumers, decomposers, and abiotic components of an ecosystem
components.cc_component_description: Describe how matter cycles among producers, consumers, decomposers, and abiotic components of an ecosystem

components.description_pt: Construir um modelo mostrando o fluxo de energia através de partes vivas e não vivas de um ecossistema
components.description_en: Construct a model showing the flow of energy through living and nonliving parts of an ecosystem
components.cc_component_description: Construct a model showing the flow of energy through living and nonliving parts of an ecosystem

components.description_pt: Distinguir entre a ciclagem de matéria e o fluxo unidirecional de energia em um modelo de ecossistema
components.description_en: Distinguish between the cycling of matter and the unidirectional flow of energy in an ecosystem model
components.cc_component_description: Distinguish between the cycling of matter and the unidirectional flow of energy in an ecosystem model

components.description_pt: Identificar os papéis de componentes vivos e não vivos na ciclagem de matéria e no fluxo de energia
components.description_en: Identify the roles of living and nonliving components in both matter cycling and energy flow
components.cc_component_description: Construct a model showing the flow of energy through living and nonliving parts of an ecosystem

cc_matches.description: Develop a model to describe the cycling of matter and flow of energy among living and nonliving parts of an ecosystem.
